structured_output.content: The change affects Kubernetes Ingress `pathType` configuration in cert-manager v1.18.0. The reported environment snapshot shows only `apps/v1 Deployment` and `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` manifest apiVersions, with no Ingress resources listed. However, the environment summary is bounded (showing samples), so additional Ingress manifests may exist. Verify whether your cert-manager deployment creates or manages any Ingress resources—if so, review how the `pathType` change from `ImplementationSpecific` to `Exact` affects your ingress controller configuration and routing rules.
